title: Cartwise+ Membership Move-to-Monthly Charge
content:
The move-to-monthly charge is the amount captured for the first one-month period when a Cartwise+ Membership moves from Cartwise+ Annual to Cartwise+ Monthly on a pause request.

## Definitions

1. **Value held.** The value the member still holds in the annual term is the plan-switch charge that opened the term plus the value carried into it (the annual plan's period fee less that plan-switch charge), less every prorated-annual refund booked on the membership in the last month. The last month is counted in whole months ending today; a refund dated on the same day of the month one month back is not counted.
2. **Value already run.** The annual plan's period fee multiplied by the calendar days from the term's first day up to the day before today, divided by the days in the term (the calendar days from the term's first day up to the day before it ends).
3. **Value held ahead of today.** The value held less the value already run, rounded to the cent and never below zero.
4. **Move credit.** 0.5 of the value held ahead of today, rounded to the cent.
5. **Charge.** Cartwise+ Monthly's period fee of 9.99 multiplied by a move rate of 1.0, less the move credit, rounded to the cent and never below zero.

The annual plan's period fee is the one the plan fee schedule sets for the annual plan held.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

An annual plan with a period fee of 99.00; a term from 10 January to 10 January of the next year (365 days, non-leap) opened by a plan-switch charge of 91.20; prorated-annual refunds totalling 60.51 booked on the membership in the last month; today is 25 March.

| Line | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Value held | 91.20 plus 7.80, less 60.51 | 38.49 |
| Days run | 10 January up to 24 March inclusive | 74 |
| Value already run | 99.00 multiplied by 74, divided by 365 | 20.0712… |
| Value held ahead of today | 38.49 less 20.0712…, rounded to the cent | 18.42 |
| Move credit | 0.5 of 18.42 | 9.21 |
| Charge | 9.99 multiplied by 1.0, less 9.21 | 0.78 |

## Boundary points

- Where the value already run exceeds the value held, the value held ahead of today is zero and so is the move credit; the charge is then 9.99.
- Where the move credit exceeds 9.99, the charge is zero, never negative.
- A refund booked in the last month reduces the value held; a refund dated earlier than that does not enter it.
